messages.content:
Same commit, same review. My previous response covers it:

```json
{
  "summary": "Added template skipping logic for inter-review, discussion, and meeting tasks to return default reflection template. Also fixed review template detection to exclude inter-review tasks.",
  "learnings": [
    {"topic": "Regex patterns", "reminder": "Avoid overly broad patterns like /participat/i - they match unintended words (participant, participate). Use word boundaries like /\\bparticipat/i instead"},
    {"topic": "Consistent anchoring", "reminder": "Be consistent with regex anchors. Use \\b for word boundaries instead of mixing ^/$ with partial matches"},
    {"topic": "Duplicate logic", "reminder": "Don't check !title.includes('inter') separately when inter-review is already in SKIP_TEMPLATE_PATTERNS - it's redundant"},
    {"topic": "Edge cases in string matching", "reminder": "title.includes('inter') is fragile - it matches 'internal', 'intervention'. Better to use regex like /\\binter-?review\\b/i for precise matching"},
    {"topic": "Silent operations", "reminder": "Silent skipping with no logging makes debugging difficult. Add logger.debug when skipping templates"}
  ],
  "issues": [
    {"severity": "medium", "type": "false-positive-risk", "location": "line 356", "description": "/participat/i is too broad - matches 'participant', 'participate', 'participating'"},
    {"severity": "medium", "type": "fragile-logic", "location": "line 398", "description": "title.includes('inter') incorrectly excludes 'internal review', 'intervention review'"},
    {"severity": "low", "type": "duplicate-logic", "location": "line 398", "description": "The !title.includes('inter') check is redundant since inter-review is already in SKIP_TEMPLATE_PATTERNS"},
    {"severity": "low", "type": "inconsistent-patterns", "location": "lines 351-357", "description": "Some patterns use anchors (^/$) while others don't"}
  ],
  "suggestions": [
    {"priority": "high", "suggestion": "Add tests for the new skip functionality: test inter-review, discussion, meeting, participate return default template"},
    {"priority": "medium", "suggestion": "Replace /participat/i with /\\bparticipat/i to require word boundary at start"},
    {"priority": "medium", "suggestion": "Remove the !title.includes('inter') check since inter-review is already in skip patterns"},
    {"priority": "low", "suggestion": "Add debug logging when shouldSkipTemplate returns true for traceability"}
  ],
  "praise": ["Good separation of concerns with shouldSkipTemplate method", "Using static readonly for the pattern array is correct", "Efficient use of Array.some() for pattern matching"],
  "overallScore": 70,
  "codeQualityScore": 65,
  "testCoverageScore": 50,
  "documentationScore": 40
}
```
